svg.title: Разведение гантелей в стороны сидя — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. SEATED DUMBBELL LATERAL RAISE on a flat weight bench. BOTH figures visibly seated with hips supported by horizontal seat and feet on floor; bench legs visible. Left: arms hanging alongside thighs, dumbbell each hand. Right: arms lifted OUT TO SIDES to shoulder height, slight elbow bend, dumbbells at shoulder height; torso remains seated upright. Full front 3/4 view. Not a shoulder press and not standing. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
